/-! ### minimum selection -/

lemma pickMin_mem : ∀ (cands : List (List MSTEdge)) (best : List MSTEdge),
    pickMin best cands = best ∨ pickMin best cands ∈ cands
  | [], best => Or.inl rfl
  | c :: rest, best => by
      simp only [pickMin]
      rcases pickMin_mem rest (if total_weight c < total_weight best then c else best) with h | h
      · by_cases hlt : total_weight c < total_weight best
        · right
          rw [h, if_pos hlt]
          simp
        · left
          rw [h, if_neg hlt]
      · right
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h

lemma pickMin_le_best : ∀ (cands : List (List MSTEdge)) (best : List MSTEdge),
    total_weight (pickMin best cands) ≤ total_weight best
  | [], best => by simp only [pickMin]; exact le_refl _
  | c :: rest, best => by
      simp only [pickMin]
      have h := pickMin_le_best rest (if total_weight c < total_weight best then c else best)
      by_cases hlt : total_weight c < total_weight best
      · rw [if_pos hlt] at h ⊢
        exact le_trans h (le_of_lt hlt)
      · rw [if_neg hlt] at h ⊢
        exact h

lemma pickMin_le : ∀ (cands : List (List MSTEdge)) (best : List MSTEdge) (o : List MSTEdge),
    o ∈ cands → total_weight (pickMin best cands) ≤ total_weight o
  | [], best, o, ho => by simp at ho
  | c :: rest, best, o, ho => by
      simp only [pickMin]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp ho with h | h
      · subst h
        by_cases hlt : total_weight o < total_weight best
        · rw [if_pos hlt]
          exact pickMin_le_best rest o
        · rw [if_neg hlt]
          push_neg at hlt
          exact le_trans (pickMin_le_best rest best) hlt
      · exact pickMin_le rest _ o h

import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def prim_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded ∧
  -- Undirected: if u→v with weight w exists, then so does v→u with the same weight
  (∀ u v w, graph.has_edge u v w → graph.has_edge v u w)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def touchedBy (S : Finset Nat) (v : Nat) (e : MSTEdge) : Bool :=
  (e.u == v && decide (e.v ∈ S)) || (e.v == v && decide (e.u ∈ S))

def expandStep (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) (S : Finset Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  (Finset.range n).filter (fun v => v ∈ S ∨ ∃ e ∈ C, touchedBy S v e = true)

def checkConn (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) : Bool :=
  decide (∀ v, v < n → v ∈ (expandStep n C)^[n] {0})

def edgesOf (g : WeightedGraph) (u : Nat) : List MSTEdge :=
  ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).map (fun pr => ⟨u, pr.1, pr.2⟩)

def allEdgesUpTo (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat → List MSTEdge
  | 0 => []
  | k + 1 => edgesOf g k ++ allEdgesUpTo g k

def allValidEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge := allEdgesUpTo g g.size

def prependEach : List MSTEdge → List (List MSTEdge) → List (List MSTEdge)
  | [], _ => []
  | e :: es, ls => ls.map (fun l => e :: l) ++ prependEach es ls

def allLists : Nat → List MSTEdge → List (List MSTEdge)
  | 0, _ => [[]]
  | k + 1, E => prependEach E (allLists k E)

def pickMin : List MSTEdge → List (List MSTEdge) → List MSTEdge
  | best, [] => best
  | best, c :: rest => pickMin (if total_weight c < total_weight best then c else best) rest

def pickList : List (List MSTEdge) → List MSTEdge
  | [] => []
  | C :: rest => pickMin C rest
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def prim_mst (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : prim_mst_precond graph) : List MSTEdge :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  pickList ((allLists (graph.size - 1) (allValidEdges graph)).filter
    (fun C => checkConn graph.size C))
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def prim_mst_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (result : List MSTEdge)
    (_ : prim_mst_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_mst graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

lemma isChain_nil' {α : Type} (R : α → α → Prop) : List.IsChain R [] := by

  | cons b s => first | rfl | simp

lemma head?_append_left {α : Type} (l1 l2 : List α) (h : l1 ≠ []) :

  | cons a t => first | rfl | simp

  apply h

  simpa using h2

lemma chain'_getD {α : Type} (R : α → α → Prop) (d : α) :
    ∀ (l : List α), List.IsChain R l ↔ ∀ i, i + 1 < l.length → R (l.getD i d) (l.getD (i + 1) d)
  | [] => by
      constructor
      · intro _ i hi
        simp only [List.length_nil] at hi
        omega
      · intro _
        exact isChain_nil' R
  | [a] => by
      constructor
      · intro _ i hi
        simp only [List.length_singleton] at hi
        omega
      · intro _
        exact isChain_single R a
  | a :: b :: t => by
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons, chain'_getD R d (b :: t)]
      constructor
      · intro h i hi
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          rw [getD_cons_succ', getD_cons_zero', getD_cons_zero']
          exact h.1
        | succ k =>
          have hk : k + 1 < (b :: t).length := by
            simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢
            omega
          rw [getD_cons_succ', getD_cons_succ']
          exact h.2 k hk
      · intro h
        refine ⟨?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
        · have h0 := h 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
          rw [getD_cons_succ', getD_cons_zero', getD_cons_zero'] at h0
          exact h0
        · have h1 := h (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢; omega)
          rw [getD_cons_succ', getD_cons_succ'] at h1
          exact h1

lemma path_follows_graph_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) :
    path_follows_graph g p ↔
      (p ≠ [] ∧ List.IsChain (fun a b => ∃ w, g.has_edge a b w) p) := by
  unfold path_follows_graph
  rw [chain'_getD (fun a b => ∃ w, g.has_edge a b w) 0 p]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, h.2⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd h.1 (by simp)
    | cons a t => simp
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, h.2⟩
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl h.1
    | cons a t => simp

/-! ### the reachability closure -/

lemma touchedBy_iff (S : Finset Nat) (v : Nat) (e : MSTEdge) :
    touchedBy S v e = true ↔ ((e.u = v ∧ e.v ∈ S) ∨ (e.v = v ∧ e.u ∈ S)) := by
  simp [touchedBy]

lemma mem_expandStep {n : Nat} {C : List MSTEdge} {S : Finset Nat} {v : Nat} :
    v ∈ expandStep n C S ↔ v < n ∧ (v ∈ S ∨ ∃ e ∈ C, touchedBy S v e = true) := by
  simp only [expandStep, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]

lemma expandStep_mono (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) {S S' : Finset Nat} (h : S ⊆ S') :
    expandStep n C S ⊆ expandStep n C S' := by
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_expandStep] at hv
  rw [mem_expandStep]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hv
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  rcases h2 with h2 | ⟨e, he, h2⟩
  · exact Or.inl (h h2)
  · refine Or.inr ⟨e, he, ?_⟩
    rw [touchedBy_iff] at h2
    rw [touchedBy_iff]
    rcases h2 with ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨ha, h hb⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨ha, h hb⟩

lemma expandStep_subset_range (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) (S : Finset Nat) :
    expandStep n C S ⊆ Finset.range n := by
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_expandStep] at hv
  exact Finset.mem_range.mpr hv.1

lemma subset_expandStep (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) (S : Finset Nat)
    (h : S ⊆ Finset.range n) : S ⊆ expandStep n C S := by
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_expandStep]
  exact ⟨Finset.mem_range.mp (h hv), Or.inl hv⟩

lemma iter_subset_range (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∀ k, (expandStep n C)^[k] {0} ⊆ Finset.range n
  | 0 => by
      intro v hv
      simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
      subst hv
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr hn
  | k + 1 => by
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      exact expandStep_subset_range n C _

lemma iter_mono_step (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∀ k, (expandStep n C)^[k] {0} ⊆ (expandStep n C)^[k + 1] {0}
  | 0 => by
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      exact subset_expandStep n C _ (iter_subset_range n C hn 0)
  | k + 1 => by
      have ih := iter_mono_step n C hn k
      simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] at ih ⊢
      exact expandStep_mono n C ih

lemma iter_mono (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) (hn : 0 < n) (k : Nat) :
    ∀ m, (expandStep n C)^[k] {0} ⊆ (expandStep n C)^[k + m] {0} := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => exact Finset.Subset.refl _
  | succ m ih =>
    have h2 := iter_mono_step n C hn (k + m)
    have h3 : k + (m + 1) = (k + m) + 1 := by omega
    rw [h3]
    exact Finset.Subset.trans ih h2

lemma iter_stab (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) (j : Nat)
    (h : (expandStep n C)^[j] {0} = (expandStep n C)^[j + 1] {0}) :
    ∀ m, (expandStep n C)^[j] {0} = (expandStep n C)^[j + m] {0} := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    have e1 : (expandStep n C)^[j + (m + 1)] {0}
        = expandStep n C ((expandStep n C)^[j + m] {0}) := by
      have h2 : j + (m + 1) = (j + m) + 1 := by omega
      rw [h2, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    rw [e1, ← ih]
    calc (expandStep n C)^[j] {0} = (expandStep n C)^[j + 1] {0} := h
      _ = expandStep n C ((expandStep n C)^[j] {0}) := Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

lemma iter_fixed (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (expandStep n C)^[n] {0} = (expandStep n C)^[n + 1] {0} := by
  by_contra hcon
  have hstrict : ∀ j, j ≤ n →
      (expandStep n C)^[j] {0} ⊂ (expandStep n C)^[j + 1] {0} := by
    intro j hj
    have hne : (expandStep n C)^[j] {0} ≠ (expandStep n C)^[j + 1] {0} := by
      intro heq
      apply hcon
      have h1 := iter_stab n C j heq (n - j)
      have h2 := iter_stab n C j heq (n + 1 - j)
      rw [show j + (n - j) = n by omega] at h1
      rw [show j + (n + 1 - j) = n + 1 by omega] at h2
      rw [← h1, ← h2]
    have hsub := iter_mono_step n C hn j
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hsub hne
  have hcard : ∀ j, j ≤ n + 1 → j + 1 ≤ ((expandStep n C)^[j] {0}).card := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro _; simp
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      have h1 := hstrict j (by omega)
      have h2 := Finset.card_lt_card h1
      have h3 := ih (by omega)
      omega
  have h3 := hcard (n + 1) (by omega)
  have h4 : ((expandStep n C)^[n + 1] {0}).card ≤ n := by
    have hs := iter_subset_range n C hn (n + 1)
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hs
    simpa using hc
  omega

lemma reach_to_path (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge) :
    ∀ k v, v ∈ (expandStep n C)^[k] {0} →
      ∃ p : List Nat, p.head? = some 0 ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧
        List.IsChain (edges_contain C) p := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v hv
    simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    subst hv
    exact ⟨[0], by simp, by simp, isChain_single _ _⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hv
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', mem_expandStep] at hv
    obtain ⟨hvn, hcase⟩ := hv
    rcases hcase with h | ⟨e, heC, hte⟩
    · exact ih v h
    · rw [touchedBy_iff] at hte
      rcases hte with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := ih e.v h2
        have hpne : p ≠ [] := by intro hc; rw [hc] at hp1; simp at hp1
        refine ⟨p ++ [v], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [head?_append_left p [v] hpne]; exact hp1
        · rw [my_getLast?_append]; first | rfl | simp
        · refine chain'_append_my _ p [v] hp3 (isChain_single _ _) ?_
          intro x hx y hy
          rw [hp2] at hx
          have hx' : x = e.v := (Option.some.inj hx).symm
          have h0 : (some v : Option Nat) = some y := hy
          have hy' : v = y := Option.some.inj h0
          subst hx'
          subst hy'
          exact ⟨e, heC, Or.inr ⟨h1, rfl⟩⟩
      · obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := ih e.u h2
        have hpne : p ≠ [] := by intro hc; rw [hc] at hp1; simp at hp1
        refine ⟨p ++ [v], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [head?_append_left p [v] hpne]; exact hp1
        · rw [my_getLast?_append]; first | rfl | simp
        · refine chain'_append_my _ p [v] hp3 (isChain_single _ _) ?_
          intro x hx y hy
          rw [hp2] at hx
          have hx' : x = e.u := (Option.some.inj hx).symm
          have h0 : (some v : Option Nat) = some y := hy
          have hy' : v = y := Option.some.inj h0
          subst hx'
          subst hy'
          exact ⟨e, heC, Or.inl ⟨rfl, h1⟩⟩

lemma path_to_reach (n : Nat) (C : List MSTEdge)
    (hb : ∀ e ∈ C, e.u < n ∧ e.v < n) :
    ∀ k (p : List Nat) (v : Nat), p.length = k + 1 → p.head? = some 0 →
      p.getLast? = some v → List.IsChain (edges_contain C) p →
      v ∈ (expandStep n C)^[k] {0} := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro p v hlen h1 h2 _
    cases p with
    | nil => simp at hlen
    | cons a t =>
      have ht : t = [] := by
        cases t with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons b s => simp at hlen
      subst ht
      have e1 : (some a : Option Nat) = some 0 := h1
      have e2 : (some a : Option Nat) = some v := h2
      have e1' : a = 0 := Option.some.inj e1
      have e2' : a = v := Option.some.inj e2
      simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, Finset.mem_singleton]
      omega
  | succ k ih =>
    intro p v hlen h1 h2 hch
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_append_of_getLast? p v h2
    subst hq
    have hqlen : q.length + 1 = k + 1 + 1 := by simpa using hlen
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q.length := by omega
    have hqne : q ≠ [] := by
      intro hc; subst hc; simp at hq1
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_getLast? q hqne
    have hqh : q.head? = some 0 := by
      rw [← head?_append_left q [v] hqne]; exact h1
    obtain ⟨hqc, hR⟩ := chain'_snoc_elim _ q v u hu hch
    have hmem := ih q u (by omega) hqh hu hqc
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', mem_expandStep]
    obtain ⟨e, heC, hcase⟩ := hR
    rcases hcase with ⟨ha, hbv⟩ | ⟨ha, hbv⟩
    · refine ⟨?_, Or.inr ⟨e, heC, ?_⟩⟩
      · have h5 := (hb e heC).2
        omega
      · rw [touchedBy_iff]
        refine Or.inr ⟨hbv, ?_⟩
        rw [ha]
        exact hmem
    · refine ⟨?_, Or.inr ⟨e, heC, ?_⟩⟩
      · have h5 := (hb e heC).1
        omega
      · rw [touchedBy_iff]
        refine Or.inl ⟨ha, ?_⟩
        rw [hbv]
        exact hmem

/-! ### bridging checkConn and connectivity -/

lemma conn_of_checkConn (g : WeightedGraph) (C : List MSTEdge)
    (h : checkConn g.size C = true) : is_connected_with_edges g C := by
  have h' : ∀ v, v < g.size → v ∈ (expandStep g.size C)^[g.size] {0} := by
    have h2 := h
    simp only [checkConn, decide_eq_true_eq] at h2
    exact h2
  intro u v hu hv
  obtain ⟨pu, hu1, hu2, hu3⟩ := reach_to_path g.size C g.size u (h' u hu)
  obtain ⟨pv, hv1, hv2, hv3⟩ := reach_to_path g.size C g.size v (h' v hv)
  obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr2, hr3⟩ :=
    path_trans (edges_contain C) (edges_contain_symm C) pu pv 0 u v hu1 hu2 hu3 hv1 hv2 hv3
  refine ⟨r, hr1, hr2, ?_⟩
  rw [path_follows_edges_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, hr3⟩
  intro hc; rw [hc] at hr1; simp at hr1

lemma checkConn_of_conn (g : WeightedGraph) (C : List MSTEdge) (hpos : 0 < g.size)
    (hb : ∀ e ∈ C, e.u < g.size ∧ e.v < g.size)
    (h : is_connected_with_edges g C) : checkConn g.size C = true := by
  simp only [checkConn, decide_eq_true_eq]
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := h 0 v hpos hv
  rw [path_follows_edges_iff] at hp3
  obtain ⟨hne, hch⟩ := hp3
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, p.length = k + 1 := by
    cases p with
    | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
    | cons a t => exact ⟨t.length, by simp⟩
  have hmem := path_to_reach g.size C hb k p v hk hp1 hp2 hch
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k g.size with hlt | hge
  · have hsub := iter_mono g.size C hpos k (g.size - k)
    rw [show k + (g.size - k) = g.size by omega] at hsub
    exact hsub hmem
  · have hfix := iter_fixed g.size C hpos
    have hstab := iter_stab g.size C g.size hfix (k - g.size)
    rw [show g.size + (k - g.size) = k by omega] at hstab
    rw [← hstab] at hmem
    exact hmem

/-! ### the edge pool and the enumeration -/

lemma bounds_of_valid (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (e : MSTEdge)
    (h : e.is_valid g) : e.u < g.size ∧ e.v < g.size := by
  obtain ⟨hu, pair, hpair, h1, h2⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
  have h3 := (hwf e.u hu).1 pair hpair
  rw [h1] at h3
  exact h3

lemma mem_allEdgesUpTo (g : WeightedGraph) : ∀ (k : Nat) (e : MSTEdge),
    e ∈ allEdgesUpTo g k ↔ ∃ u, u < k ∧ e ∈ edgesOf g u
  | 0, e => by simp [allEdgesUpTo]
  | k + 1, e => by
      simp only [allEdgesUpTo, List.mem_append, mem_allEdgesUpTo g k]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | ⟨u, hu, he⟩)
        · exact ⟨k, by omega, h⟩
        · exact ⟨u, by omega, he⟩
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, he⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u k with h | h
        · exact Or.inr ⟨u, h, he⟩
        · have huk : u = k := by omega
          subst huk
          exact Or.inl he

lemma mem_allValidEdges_of_valid (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) (h : e.is_valid g) :
    e ∈ allValidEdges g := by
  obtain ⟨hu, pair, hpair, h1, h2⟩ := h
  rw [allValidEdges, mem_allEdgesUpTo]
  refine ⟨e.u, hu, ?_⟩
  rw [edgesOf, List.mem_map]
  refine ⟨pair, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hpair
  · show MSTEdge.mk e.u pair.1 pair.2 = e
    rw [h1, h2]

lemma valid_of_mem_allValidEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge)
    (h : e ∈ allValidEdges g) : e.is_valid g := by
  rw [allValidEdges, mem_allEdgesUpTo] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := h
  rw [edgesOf, List.mem_map] at he
  obtain ⟨pair, hpair, heq⟩ := he
  subst heq
  exact ⟨hu, pair, by simpa using hpair, rfl, rfl⟩

lemma mem_prependEach : ∀ (E : List MSTEdge) (ls : List (List MSTEdge)) (L : List MSTEdge),
    L ∈ prependEach E ls ↔ ∃ e l, e ∈ E ∧ l ∈ ls ∧ L = e :: l
  | [], ls, L => by simp [prependEach]
  | e :: es, ls, L => by
      simp only [prependEach, List.mem_append, List.mem_map, mem_prependEach es ls L]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨l, hl, hL⟩ | ⟨e', l, he', hl, hL⟩)
        · exact ⟨e, l, by simp, hl, hL.symm⟩
        · exact ⟨e', l, by simp [he'], hl, hL⟩
      · rintro ⟨e', l, he', hl, hL⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp he' with h | h
        · subst h
          exact Or.inl ⟨l, hl, hL.symm⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨e', l, h, hl, hL⟩

lemma mem_allLists : ∀ (k : Nat) (E : List MSTEdge) (L : List MSTEdge),
    L ∈ allLists k E ↔ (L.length = k ∧ ∀ e ∈ L, e ∈ E)
  | 0, E, L => by
      constructor
      · intro h
        have hL : L = [] := by simpa [allLists] using h
        subst hL
        simp
      · intro h
        cases L with
        | nil => simp [allLists]
        | cons a t => simp at h
  | k + 1, E, L => by
      rw [allLists, mem_prependEach]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨e, l, he, hl, hL⟩
        subst hL
        have hrec := (mem_allLists k E l).mp hl
        refine ⟨by simp [hrec.1], ?_⟩
        intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
        · subst h; exact he
        · exact hrec.2 x h
      · intro h
        cases L with
        | nil => simp at h
        | cons a t =>
          refine ⟨a, t, h.2 a (by simp), ?_, rfl⟩
          refine (mem_allLists k E t).mpr ⟨by simpa using h.1, ?_⟩
          intro x hx
          exact h.2 x (by simp [hx])

/-! ### minimum selection -/

lemma pickMin_mem : ∀ (cands : List (List MSTEdge)) (best : List MSTEdge),
    pickMin best cands = best ∨ pickMin best cands ∈ cands
  | [], best => Or.inl rfl
  | c :: rest, best => by
      simp only [pickMin]
      rcases pickMin_mem rest (if total_weight c < total_weight best then c else best) with h | h
      · by_cases hlt : total_weight c < total_weight best
        · right
          rw [h, if_pos hlt]
          simp
        · left
          rw [h, if_neg hlt]
      · right
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h

lemma pickMin_le_best : ∀ (cands : List (List MSTEdge)) (best : List MSTEdge),
    total_weight (pickMin best cands) ≤ total_weight best
  | [], best => by simp only [pickMin]; exact le_refl _
  | c :: rest, best => by
      simp only [pickMin]
      have h := pickMin_le_best rest (if total_weight c < total_weight best then c else best)
      by_cases hlt : total_weight c < total_weight best
      · rw [if_pos hlt] at h ⊢
        exact le_trans h (le_of_lt hlt)
      · rw [if_neg hlt] at h ⊢
        exact h

lemma pickMin_le : ∀ (cands : List (List MSTEdge)) (best : List MSTEdge) (o : List MSTEdge),
    o ∈ cands → total_weight (pickMin best cands) ≤ total_weight o
  | [], best, o, ho => by simp at ho
  | c :: rest, best, o, ho => by
      simp only [pickMin]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp ho with h | h
      · subst h
        by_cases hlt : total_weight o < total_weight best
        · rw [if_pos hlt]
          exact pickMin_le_best rest o
        · rw [if_neg hlt]
          push_neg at hlt
          exact le_trans (pickMin_le_best rest best) hlt
      · exact pickMin_le rest _ o h

lemma pickList_mem : ∀ (L : List (List MSTEdge)), L ≠ [] → pickList L ∈ L
  | [], h => absurd rfl h
  | C :: rest, _ => by
      simp only [pickList]
      rcases pickMin_mem rest C with h | h
      · rw [h]; simp
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h

lemma pickList_le : ∀ (L : List (List MSTEdge)) (o : List MSTEdge), o ∈ L →
    total_weight (pickList L) ≤ total_weight o
  | [], o, ho => by simp at ho
  | C :: rest, o, ho => by
      simp only [pickList]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp ho with h | h
      · subst h
        exact pickMin_le_best rest o
      · exact pickMin_le rest C o h

/-! ### existence of a spanning tree -/

lemma exists_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hpos : 0 < g.size)
    (hconn : g.is_connected) : ∃ T : List MSTEdge, is_spanning_tree g T := by
  classical
  let Rs : Nat → Set Nat := fun v =>
    {k | ∃ p : List Nat, p.head? = some 0 ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧
      List.IsChain (fun a b => ∃ w, g.has_edge a b w) p ∧ p.length = k + 1}
  have hne : ∀ v, v < g.size → (Rs v).Nonempty := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := hconn 0 v hpos hv
    rw [path_follows_graph_iff] at hp3
    obtain ⟨hpne, hch⟩ := hp3
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, p.length = k + 1 := by
      cases p with
      | nil => exact absurd rfl hpne
      | cons a t => exact ⟨t.length, by simp⟩
    exact ⟨k, p, hp1, hp2, hch, hk⟩
  let D : Nat → Nat := fun v => sInf (Rs v)
  have hDmem : ∀ v, v < g.size → D v ∈ Rs v := fun v hv => Nat.sInf_mem (hne v hv)
  have hDle : ∀ v k, k ∈ Rs v → D v ≤ k := fun v k hk => Nat.sInf_le hk
  have hD0 : D 0 = 0 := by
    have h0 : (0 : Nat) ∈ Rs 0 :=
      ⟨[0], by simp, by simp, isChain_single _ _, by simp⟩
    have h1 := hDle 0 0 h0
    omega
  have hDpos : ∀ v, v < g.size → v ≠ 0 → 0 < D v := by
    intro v hv hv0
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (D v) with h | h
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, _, hlen⟩ := hDmem v hv
      rw [h] at hlen
      cases p with
      | nil => simp at hlen
      | cons a t =>
        have ht : t = [] := by
          cases t with
          | nil => rfl
          | cons b s => simp at hlen
        subst ht
        have e1 : (some a : Option Nat) = some 0 := hp1
        have e2 : (some a : Option Nat) = some v := hp2
        have e1' : a = 0 := Option.some.inj e1
        have e2' : a = v := Option.some.inj e2
        exact hv0 (by omega)
    · exact h
  have hkey : ∀ v, ∃ uw : Nat × Int, v < g.size → 0 < D v →
      (g.has_edge uw.1 v uw.2 ∧ D uw.1 < D v) := by
    intro v
    by_cases hc : v < g.size ∧ 0 < D v
    · obtain ⟨hv, hdv⟩ := hc
      obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hpc, hlen⟩ := hDmem v hv
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_append_of_getLast? p v hp2
      subst hq
      have hqlen : q.length + 1 = D v + 1 := by simpa using hlen
      have hq1 : 1 ≤ q.length := by omega
      have hqne : q ≠ [] := by
        intro hcc; subst hcc; simp at hq1
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_getLast? q hqne
      obtain ⟨hqc, hR⟩ := chain'_snoc_elim _ q v u hu hpc
